answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fakes. Each epoch, two random peers check an agent's work, its 20-unit deposit receipt, and whether a claimed wharf shipment matches a river log. A haven of agents publishes audit histories, so a fake passing faces a new pair next epoch. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 = 2000 units plus 100 histories; one honest agent pays 20 and earns undiluted rewards. Auditors falsely clearing a fake lose their deposit.
